svg.text: Everyday English - Quote
Progress is easier to notice
when we pause to look back.
MEANING
Reflecting on earlier efforts can reveal improvement
that feels invisible day to day.
IN CONTEXT
Reviewing her first recording, Maya said, “Progress is
easier to notice when we pause to look back.” She
could hear how much smoother her speech had
become.
USAGE NOTE
Look back means reflect on the past here. Use this
sentence to encourage someone to recognize gradual
progress; pausing to reflect does not mean giving up
on improvement.
CONVERSATION
A: My English still feels the same.
B: “Progress is easier to notice when we pause to look
back.” Listen to your first recording.
A: I used to hesitate after every sentence. Now I barely
pause.
B: That is a concrete sign of progress.
YOUR TURN
Quote the line, then describe one specific
before-and-after change. Model: I used to read from
notes; now I can explain the idea without them.
